pages.text: The Hookah collection now includes a short dyeable Hookah, a roughly 1.5-block-tall $(thing)Tall Hookah$(), and a range of similarly tall material designs. These taller Hookahs reserve the block above them for clean placement. All use the same fuel, shisha, water, hose, quality, and Dirty Water rules; material choice is cosmetic.

pages.title: Copper Ages
pages.text: The $(thing)Copper Hookah$() naturally oxidizes through Exposed, Weathered, and Oxidized appearances. Right-click any unwaxed stage with Honeycomb to preserve that finish. An axe removes wax first, then scrapes oxidation backward one stage. Its inventory and active Hookah state are preserved while the block changes.

pages.title: Decoration
pages.text: The short Hookah and Tall Hookah can both be recolored in-world with any Dye and made luminous with a Glow Ink Sac. The Netherite Hookah also gives off an occasional subtle purple ambient particle as a purely cosmetic prestige effect.
